Players Committee card image of [[Luke Skywalker, The Rebellion's Hope]] (original printing), game text: “Adds 3 to power of anything he pilots. If armed with a blaster or rifle at a site (or piloting Red 5), may add one destiny to total power or attrition. Run Luke, Run! is a Used Interrupt. Immune to attrition < 4.”

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual8-Light/large/lukeskywalkertherebellionshope.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153 022435b] (8 July 2018). The PC serves its card images from this repository at res.starwarsccg.org; this is an earlier version of that file.

Edits: none. The repository's bytes are uploaded unchanged.
